text:
viv: quick heads-up from onboarding an OrionX-derived 7B (gguf -> int8): generation looks fine for short contexts but after ~1k tokens output becomes garbled when tokenizer.pad_token_id != 0. reproducible on local runtime.

sam: this sounds like the head-permutation + packer-index class we've seen. did the gguf include any layout metadata?

nina: checked file: gguf contains a non-canonical "head_permutation" entry (per-head ordering not 0..N-1). runtime expects contiguous head-major layout so some heads point at wrong kv slices.

viv: minimal repro I used: 
```
# tokens around pad boundary
input_ids = [10, 22, 303, 1023, 4, 4, 4]  # pad_token_id = 4
config = {"use_cache": True, "max_new_tokens": 64}
# run, then inspect kv_offsets and logits around the boundary
```

sam: fp16 binary behaves; int8 conversion shows the corruption -> suggests converter left a packed-permuted layout and our int8 packer assumed canonical ordering.

nina: confirmed: kv_offsets show heads 0..7 aligned, heads 8..15 shifted by half-stride. combined with packer logic that uses pad-derived offsets, some heads index into padded region producing garbage.

viv: short-term mitigations: (1) loader-level canonicalization: apply head_permutation at load time (memory copy, ~10% cold-start hit) behind a flag for onboarding jobs; (2) gating in onboarding: detect head_permutation metadata and fail with actionable guidance.

sam: long-term: change model-converters to rewrite weights into canonical ordering on export so runtime can do zero-copy load.

nina: operational actions: add a pad-sweep smoke in onboarding (pad_token_id 0..15) on long-context sequences; add a unit/integration test in runtime packers that validates pad_token_id invariance for kv indexing.

onboard-bot: job queued: orionx-int8-pad-sweep (job id: 12001)

viv: uploaded a small failing weight slice + head_map and kv_offsets dump to s3://redwood-onboard/orionx/1777777777/debug-slices.tar.gz for the runtime team.

sam: I'll add a regression test with the failing slice and a converter roundtrip test (fp16 -> int8) to catch this earlier.

nina: I'll open the model-converters PR to emit canonical-ordered gguf by default and add an int8 roundtrip unit. also will document loader flag for re-layout as a temporary workaround.

viv: thanks all — leaving detailed steps in the onboarding ticket and will follow up with perf numbers for loader re-layout. :thumbsup:
